name: Monday Night Football
description: Howard Cosell hosted the first instalment of Monday Night Football.

videos.title: New York Jets @ Cleveland Browns
videos.overview: Monday Night Football debuts with Howard Cosell hosting along with Frank Gifford and Don Meredith.

videos.title: Kansas City Chiefs @ Baltimore Colts
videos.overview: Johnny Unitas gets pulled from the game after throwing 2 interceptions in the first half and Len Dawson throws 4 TDs to seal the game for the Chiefs.

videos.title: Chicago Bears @ Detroit Lions
videos.overview: Future defensive line coach for the Steelers, Dick LeBeau gets 2 interceptions to beat the Bears.

videos.title: Green Bay Packers @ San Diego Chargers
videos.overview: Green Bay get 2 TD passes from Bart Starr and a late field goal to beat the Chargers

videos.title: Washington Redskins @ Oakland Raiders
videos.overview: John Madden makes his MNF debut as coach of the Raiders

videos.title: Los Angeles Rams @ Minnesota Vikings
videos.overview: Howard Cosell gives updates on the recently reinstated Mohamed Ali fight with Jerry Quarry.

videos.title: Cincinnati Bengals @ Pittsburgh Steelers
videos.overview: Rookie Terry Bradshaw makes his MNF debut.

videos.title: New York Giants @ Philadelphia Eagles
videos.overview: An intoxicated Howard Cosell made it through the first half and threw up on Don Meredith's boots at halftime. Cosell left before the second half, leaving Meredith to finish the game with Keith Jackson.

videos.title: New York Jets @ St Louis Cardinals
St Louis Cardinals @ San Diego Chargers
Kansas City Chiefs @ New Orleans Saints
Oakland Raiders @ Houston Oilers
videos.overview: This is the “We’re number one in the nation” broadcast. Don Meredith’s reaction to unhappy fans watching their Oilers lose again.

videos.title: St Louis Cardinals @ Miami Dolphins
videos.overview: Miami makes it 11-0 on route to their perfect season.

videos.title: New York Jets @ Oakland Raiders
videos.overview: Jets receiver Don Maynard sets a new all time receptions record with 632. It would only stand for 3 years.

videos.title: New York Jets @ Green Bay Packers
Dallas Cowboys @ Washington Redskins
videos.overview: Ken Houston stops Walt Garrison on the 1 yard line as time expires to give Washington the win.

videos.title: Oakland Raiders @ Denver Broncos
videos.overview: Don Meredith announces “We’re in the Mile High City, so am I”

videos.title: Kansas City Chiefs @ Buffalo Bills
videos.overview: Don Meredith is drunk during the broadcast

videos.title: Washington Redskins @ Pittsburgh Steelers
videos.overview: Don Meredith refers to the president as “Tricky Dick”

videos.title: New York Giants @ Los Angeles Rams
Dallas Cowboys @ Oakland Raiders
videos.overview: Monday Night Football airs its first Saturday game for the final regular season game.

videos.title: 1975 Probowl AFC vs NFC from the Orange Bowl in Miami, Florida
videos.overview: Monday Night Football broadcasts its first ProBowl.

videos.title: Oakland Raider @ Miami Dolphins
videos.overview: Dolphins enter the game with 31 consecutive home wins. During halftime, Harry Reasoner, ABC anchorman gives an update on the assassination attempt on president Gerald Ford a few hours before the game.

videos.title: Dallas Cowboys @ Detroit Lions
videos.overview: Detroit Lions open their new stadium, The Pontiac Silverdome.

videos.title: Kansas City Chiefs @ Dallas Cowboys
videos.overview: Golden Richards makes a 1 handed tip grab in the end zone for Dallas.

videos.title: New York Jets @ San Diego Chargers
Miami Dolphins @ Buffalo Bills
videos.overview: A new theme song is introduced.

videos.title: Washington Redskins @ Philadelphia Eagles
videos.overview: Monday Night Football sees its first overtime game.

videos.title: San Francisco 49ers @ Los Angeles Rams
videos.overview: 49ers defensive end, Tommy Hart gets 6 sacks.

videos.title: New York Jets @ New England Patriots
videos.overview: Color analyst sings a New York Jets fight song written by Jets Coach Lou Holtz.

videos.title: 1977 ProBowl AFC vs NFC
videos.overview: 1977 ProBowl from The Kingdom, Seattle, Washington

videos.title: Los Angeles Rams @ Chicago Bears
videos.overview: Joe Namath gets the starting role in his final NFL game.

videos.title: New York Giants @ St Louis Cardinals
Baltimore Colts @ Dallas Cowboys
videos.overview: The Crew enjoy nachos during the game and help popularize the Texan snack.

videos.title: New England Patriots @ Oakland Raiders
videos.overview: MNF airs a Sunday night game for the first time.

videos.title: Minnesota Vikings @ Dallas Cowboys
videos.overview: MNF airs their first ever Thursday night game.

videos.title: Pittsburgh Steelers @ San Francisco 49ers
videos.overview: Earlier in the day, Harvey Milk and George Moscone were murdered at San Francisco City Hall. Just before the National Anthem, a truck backed into a wooden pole and knocked it over near the end zone.

videos.title: New England Patriots @ Miami Dolphins
videos.overview: Head  Coach Chuck Fairbanks is suspended from this game because he took a Head Coaching role with the University of Colorado.
